title: World Bloom — Link the Beats!

meta.Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeaaah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What did you think of our performance?!
I hope you grow even bigger after hearing it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
How fun would that be?!
Hehehe. Grow big and strong♪

rows.Line: Oh, Miku, were you taking a peek at those other SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...!
Remember what happened to them recently?
That all seemed like quite an ordeal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've actually been checking from time to time because I was worried that something similar would happen again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're talking about the black fragments that made everyone fall asleep, right? That also really startled me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!
I honestly thought that they'd never wake up again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what they experienced seems to have made them all a little stronger.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. Their bonds have become more resilient now that they've acknowledged their precious feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those trees and their feelings must be connected together at a very deep level.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what's going to happen moving forward, but I hope they keep growing alongside everyone's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What just happened?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a very good question. I don't know either...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, what if something is happening to each of their SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean something bad is happening...?!

rows.Line: All of them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did the us in those other SEKAI just disappear...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: B-But why...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's go take a look, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't know what just happened...
But we may be able to help.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!

rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Line: I found my way here by following the presence of the me from that SEKAI...

rows.Line: But this place...
Wh-Where am I...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew it, it's the me from that SEKAI...!

rows.Line:
But how did he end up here?

rows.Line: No one else is here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What is this place...?
Everyone's gone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does this mean I'll never see them again...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Len

I don't know what happened, but I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-Why's there another me here...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Where did you come from?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-I'm also not sure what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I somehow ended up here all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of a sudden? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For now, come with me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't know why you're here, but I can't just leave you all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku and the others are in that classroom, so I'll take you to them. Follow me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You found another Len...?!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, at the station.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But he has no idea how he got here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... I-I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, you don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd KAITO and Rin go?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wait, weren't they at the station?
It's their turn to water the tree, so they should've been over there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The station...?
No, I didn't see them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What about you, other Len?
Did you see them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
N-No.
I didn't see anyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Th-The thing is...
I was watering the tree in my SEKAI, too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then before I knew it, I was here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Maybe those two things are connected somehow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They definitely could be.
We did have to deal with those black fragments not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And this isn't the first time something like this has happened...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, that's right...!
You met that Len from another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
That time, I ended up in a completely different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see... So, just like that time, for one reason or another, those two may've been sent over to other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Beng sent over to another SEKAI has to be pretty scary...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (This me probably has it particularly rough, since he seems kinda shy. I hope he's feeling okay...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Argh! I wish he could hear my voice!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't really understand what happened, but I made it home in the end, so I'm sure it'll all work out this time too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I mean, there's no use crying over spilt milk.
For now, you should make yourself at home.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. We still have some of that tea the girls brought over the other day. Why don't we have some together?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It should help you relax.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, you're so different from our Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's the thing.
He's like a cute, little critter, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: L-Little critter...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'd get along very well with KAITO. I can already see the two of you quietly playing instruments together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, me too.
I wish you could've met him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: P-Playing instruments...? With KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm not sure... I'm a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, why?
There's no need to be afraid.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, you gotta stop shaking every time you look at my face. You're throwing me off here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's true, the KAITO from his original SEKAI doesn't seem like the type to play with anyone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It seems like the two from this SEKAI get along pretty well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, it's not every day that you get to visit a different SEKAI, so you should take a good look around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This photo...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's a picture of Ichika and the girls when they were little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're childhood friends, and their feelings were what brought about this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're very close.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Their smiles are beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's more over here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Here's a picture of them having a sleepover.
And this one's from when they when to PXL.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's also the one of them at a festival.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. They're all so little and look absolutely adorable. Especially Shiho here nibbling on a caramel apple.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...
They do seem really close.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They became that way when they were little after stargazing and forming a band.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Stargazing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is that why the stars look so beautiful in this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That wouldn't surprise me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They've been friends since they were little...
That's so nice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a little different from how things are for everyone in my SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, but they're similar in the sense that music brought them all together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right on cue. That must be Ichika and them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You don't have to do anything.
They're not going to hurt you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. Since you're here, let us introduce you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
They're all very nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
O-Okay...
se_walk_women_002_4
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! He's Len, but from a different SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He's so different from our Len...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but you know...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's kinda cute...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
Is this what it's like to have a little brother...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry, Len, you're also like a cute little brother! Just in a slightly different way, is all!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wasn't worrying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪ Want some chips, Len?
This is a new flavor!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A new flavor...?
Are they good?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still haven't had them yet, so let's try them together! But they're watermelon-flavored, so they must be good, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Watermelon-flavored potato chips? Are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Putting out flavors no one would expect is kind of this brand's whole thing, really.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I also baked some apple pies for us to all have while we're here. I made quite a few, so please feel free to have some, Len.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I also brought snacks. You can have them, Len.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, is this what we're doing now? In that case...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What?! No fair...!
You got so many snacks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... Are you sure I can have all these?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Let's have them together♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. He seems really happy now!
I'm glad for him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. He's already the life of the party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
We should put on a show for Len!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'll be our way of welcoming you to our SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A show...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it is always better to practice in front of an audience.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we were just thinking about doing a run together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you mind listening for us, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I'd like to hear you all play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get started!
Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Amazing...
This is what your music is like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds so cool...and wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He looked really scared when he first arrived here, but he seems fine now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Len, do you wanna sing with us?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? B-But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The next verse is really easy, so let's try singing it together! What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'll join you...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, here it goes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You went a bit off the rails there, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? I did?
But it's just so fun to sing with the audience like that, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna do that during our next solo show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not surprised to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, Len, what did you think?
I know we sort of roped you in all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-That was fun...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've never really listened to this kind of music...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it was so cool, and really exciting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to do our best to make sure the crowd feels the same way during our next solo show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you girls work really hard for your fans?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, half yes and half no... I think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We do work really hard for our fans, but it's also for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You see, we were childhood friends... We spent basically every second together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we began to drift apart as we began to develop differences and have more arguments...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all wished that we could be friends again like old times, but we couldn't for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we thought that a band might be the solution.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because we all had fun playing in a band when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. So, we decided to get our band back together. So that we could be friends again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Feels kind of nostalgic to think back on it now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We got our band back together, began practicing and... Hehe. We did our first performance on a really big stage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That was a scary moment.
But it's a really precious memory now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ After that, we began producing our own songs... And the first one I wrote was for all of them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was meant to help them keep moving forward no matter how lost or worried they were!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we started to want to go pro together, and move the hearts of everyone listening to our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we could connect people together with our music...it'd be really wonderful. That's what we thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So that's what we mean by half yes, half no.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, as pros, we've still got a long road ahead of us. We have to bring our music to more and more people.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But lots of people are already listening to your music, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't really know what it's like to be a professional musician...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I can tell that you're all doing really amazing work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But we're still not capable of much since we've only just gotten started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Len, what are the people who made your SEKAI like?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How do I describe them...?
They also make songs together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They don't spend all their time together like you and your friends, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think they spend more time apart than together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! And they're able to make music like that?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe their process doesn't involve meeting in person?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisa... A friend of mine did say that she also makes music with people online.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it doesn't sound impossible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But don't they get lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry!
I just thought, if it was me, I'd feel kinda lonely if I didn't get to see my friends that much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think they feel lonely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They don't spend much time together in person...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But their hearts...
They're all connected.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Their hearts...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Even when they're not together, it's like they're all sitting right next to each other.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think that's how they feel about it...probably.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a special kind of bond.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess that means we're also going to be okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember the dream those black fragments showed us? We wanted to be with each other regardless of where we were or what we were doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'm sure we'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I also think you'll all do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, the way you played... As a “band”, right? You weaved your sounds together so well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I felt it right in my heart.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Len...
Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, Len, what kinds of songs do the people who made your SEKAI produce?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd also like to know.
Pop? EDM? Or something else?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What kinds of songs...?
Umm... I can't really say, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... What a pretty melody...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait, have I heard this song before...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Was I imagining things...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What a kind and beautiful song...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I want to keep listening as well.

rows.Line: The idol version of me seems to have arrived in this SEKAI...

rows.Line: But is she really here...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What is this place?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-Where am I...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, she's awake...!

rows.Line: I hope she's okay...

rows.Line:
Umm... I was watering the tree...
But what happened after that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I've never seen this place before.
There are no stages or flowers... It's almost as though this isn't my SEKAI at...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Was I sent to another SEKAI...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do I do? I have a lot of things to get done today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin and I need to come up with new dance routines for our next show, and I was going to discuss the set list for it with KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO and I were also going to discuss workout regimens...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, worrying about those things won't help me right now. First I need to figure out what kind of SEKAI this is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
